create_FeatherlessAIConfig: create a FeatherlessAIConfig instance with temperature, max_tokens, and frequency_penalty parameters
build_get_supported_openai_params: build a call to get_supported_openai_params to retrieve the list of supported OpenAI parameters for a model
run_map_openai_params: run map_openai_params to map non-default OpenAI params into FeatherlessAI-compatible optional params
test_validate_environment: test validate_environment to verify it sets Authorization and Content-Type headers with a valid API key
